parameters.query: SELECT json_build_object('contact', (SELECT row_to_json(c) FROM contacts c WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}'), 'activities', (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(la)) FROM lead_activities la JOIN contacts c ON c.id = la.contact_id WHERE c.email = '{{ $json.email }}'), 'deals', (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(d)) FROM deals d JOIN contacts c ON c.id = d.contact_id WHERE c.email = '{{ $json.email }}'), 'messages', (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(m)) FROM message_log m JOIN contacts c ON c.id = m.contact_id WHERE c.email = '{{ $json.email }}')) as data_export

DELETE FROM lead_activities WHERE contact_id = (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}'); DELETE FROM message_log WHERE contact_id = (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}'); UPDATE deals SET contact_id = NULL, notes = 'GDPR deletion - contact removed' WHERE contact_id = (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}'); DELETE FROM contacts WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}'; SELECT log_audit({{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}, 'gdpr-compliance', 'data_deleted', 'compliance', NULL, '{"email": "{{ $json.email }}", "request_id": "{{ $json.request_id }}"}'::jsonb, 'success')

parameters.query: WITH retention_config AS (SELECT 365 as contact_days, 90 as activity_days, 730 as deal_days, 30 as session_days) DELETE FROM lead_activities WHERE created_at < NOW() - (SELECT activity_days FROM retention_config) * INTERVAL '1 day' AND contact_id IN (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE lead_status = 'lost'); DELETE FROM user_sessions WHERE expires_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'; DELETE FROM uptime_checks WHERE checked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'; SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') as old_activities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE lead_status = 'lost' AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '365 days') as old_lost_contacts
